params.prompt: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a small real-life interior. SETTING: inside a small 24-hour neighborhood convenience store at 11 pm, about 8 by 10 meters. The store brand color is a muted slate grey-blue (#5B6B7A) with cream accents: slate blue shelf end-caps, slate blue counter front, cream price rails. Three rows of low white metal gondola shelves full of snacks, ramen cups, bread, triangle kimbap drawn as simple colorful blocks with no readable labels; a whole wall of glass-door drink refrigerators glowing (soft drinks, milk, water only); a hot water dispenser and a tiny eating counter with stools by the window; a wire basket of expired food; bright cool-white ceiling panels; the big glass front shows the dark street with an orange sodium lamp. The player character in a black school blazer stocks a shelf from a plastic crate, crouching; behind the slate blue counter a girl part-timer with a ponytail writes in a notebook. Strong teal-white store light. RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, frames, furniture and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, tile seams, wood grain lines). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in lived-in props. CAMERA: third-person game camera, lens height about 1.6 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective, the whole room readable. The reference image shows the player character (a lanky 17-year-old Korean boy with curly black hair): draw him small, standing in the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. Posters, boards, menus and labels are simple blocks of color or tiny illegible scribbles: absolutely no readable letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.
